## Intent

The doc comment on `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still ends with "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". The TODO is stale and misleading:
workspaces have existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`),
`getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and CLAUDE.md says nothing about it. A reader
(human or agent) following the TODO would add a workspace parameter the design deliberately rejects. The owner wants the
TODO replaced by a one-sentence doc-comment line stating the actual rule: the profile is per person, not per workspace,
so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.

Separately, `main` fails `npm run format:check` on one file, `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, merged unformatted
in #384. The owner wants that file run through Prettier so the gate is green again, with its formatting changed and its
wording left exactly as it is.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Replace the stale TODO line in `getProfileData`'s doc comment with one sentence stating that the profile is per
  person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Format `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier configuration so it passes the Prettier
  check.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any behaviour change to `getProfileData`: its signature, its return value and its E2E branch stay exactly as they are.
- Editing the existing profile tests.
- Changing any word of `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, or formatting any other file.
- Editing CLAUDE.md or any architecture doc.
- Adding workspace awareness to the profile in any form.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the repository after this change When every file under `features/profile/` is searched for the text
  "multi-workspace support" and for a TODO that mentions an `organizationId` parameter Then the search returns no
  match.
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` after this change When the doc comment directly above the
  exported `getProfileData` function is read Then its text states that the profile is per person (not per workspace)
  and that `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` after this change When
  `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` is run from the project root Then the command exits 0.
  - verify: integration

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>` keeps its signature, its return value and
  its E2E branch byte-for-byte; the existing profile tests stay untouched and keep passing (the regression check covers
  this).
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` changes in formatting only: after removing whitespace differences, its text is
  identical to the version on `main`.
- The project's own Prettier version and configuration are used; no Prettier configuration or ignore file changes.

## Assumptions

- The TODO at `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` line 57 is, at spec time, the only file under
  `features/profile/` containing "multi-workspace support" or an `organizationId`-parameter TODO (read this run).
- The rest of the existing doc comment ("Reads the `user` and `user_profiles` rows in parallel …") stays; only the TODO
  line is replaced.
- At spec time, `npx prettier . --check` fails on `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` only, and Prettier's change to
  it is a single inserted blank line after line 63 (read this run); the build re-runs Prettier rather than relying on
  this preview.
- Tests for AC-1 and AC-2 read source text, so they live in new test files; the existing profile tests are not edited.
- `package.json` has a `test` script (`vitest run`), so PHARN's gate discovery finds a runner for the unit criteria; the
  integration criterion runs a CLI command, and whether the test stage has a per-test runner for that level is decided
  by its own preflight.

## Intent

`features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still tells its reader, in the doc comment of `getProfileData`, "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". The TODO is stale and misleading:
workspaces have existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`),
`getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and the project instructions say nothing
about adding an organization id to it. A developer reading the comment today would believe a workspace parameter is
still owed. The comment should instead state the actual rule in one sentence: the profile is per person, not per
workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.

Separately, the repository's format gate (`npm run format:check`) is red on main because one file,
`docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, was merged unformatted. Running Prettier on that file, changing only its
formatting, makes the gate green again.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Replacing the stale TODO in the `getProfileData` doc comment with one sentence stating that the profile is per
  person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Reformatting `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier configuration so it passes
  `prettier --check`.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any behaviour change to `getProfileData`: its signature, its return value and its E2E fixture branch stay exactly as
  they are.
- Editing the existing profile tests.
- Changing any wording, heading, table content or meaning in `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`; only whitespace,
  line wrapping and other Prettier formatting may change.
- Reformatting any other file, or any other comment cleanup under `features/profile/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the `features/profile/` tree after the change When every file under it is searched for the text
  "multi-workspace support" and for a line containing both "TODO" and "organizationId" Then the search returns no
  match.
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` after the change When the doc comment immediately above
  the `getProfileData` export is read Then its text states that the profile is per person, not per workspace, and that
  `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given the repository after the change When `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` runs
  Then the command exits with status 0.
  - verify: integration

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>` keeps its signature, its return value
  and its E2E fixture branch; the existing profile tests under `features/profile/` stay untouched and keep passing.
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` changes in formatting only, never in wording, as produced by the project's own
  Prettier configuration run on that one file.
- The replacement doc-comment line is one sentence.

## Assumptions

- "A TODO about an organizationId parameter" (acceptance item 1 of the request) is read as any line containing both
  the text "TODO" and "organizationId"; AC-1 uses that test.
- AC-1 and AC-2 are observed by reading source text (the files' contents are the returned value), which is the only
  public surface a comment has.
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` is the only file failing `prettier . --check` on this branch (checked this run:
  the full check flagged that one file), so fixing it turns the whole format gate green.
- The project's `test` script (`vitest run`) is the runner for the unit criteria; AC-3 runs Prettier as a process and
  reads its exit status.
- The rest of the `getProfileData` doc comment (what it reads and its defaults) stays; only the TODO line is replaced.

## Intent

The doc comment on `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still ends with "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". That TODO is stale and misleading:
workspaces have existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`),
`getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and CLAUDE.md says nothing about such a
parameter. A reader following the TODO would add a workspace dimension the product deliberately rejected. The developer
wants the TODO replaced by one doc-comment sentence stating the actual rule: the profile is per person, not per
workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.

Separately, `main` fails `npm run format:check` (`prettier . --check`) on exactly one file,
`docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md`, merged unformatted in #384. The developer wants that file run through Prettier so
the format gate is green again, with its wording unchanged.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Replacing the stale TODO line in the `getProfileData` doc comment with one sentence stating that the profile is per
  person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
- Reformatting `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` with the project's Prettier configuration.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any change to `getProfileData`'s signature, return value or E2E (`NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MSW`) branch, or to any other code
  in `features/profile/`.
- Editing the existing profile tests under `features/profile/`.
- Changing the wording, structure or meaning of `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` — only whitespace and markdown
  formatting Prettier produces.
- Reformatting any other file, or changing the Prettier configuration or the `format:check` script.
- Any other stale TODO elsewhere in the codebase.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the repository after the change When every file under `features/profile/` is read as text Then no file
  contains the text "multi-workspace support", and no line containing "TODO" also contains "organizationId"
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` after the change When the doc comment directly preceding
  `export async function getProfileData` is read Then it contains, case-insensitively, the phrases "per person",
  "not per workspace" and "no organization id"
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given the repository after the change When `npx prettier --check docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` is run
  from the project root Then it exits with status 0
  - verify: integration

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>` keeps its signature, its return value and
  its E2E branch exactly as they are; only its doc comment changes.
- The existing profile tests stay untouched and keep passing (the regression stage covers that).
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` changes only in formatting: its words, in order, stay identical.
- The project's gates stay green: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test` and `npm run format:check`.

## Assumptions

- The replacement sentence uses the words "per person", "not per workspace" and "no organization id" (the phrasing the
  increment description gives); AC-2 checks those phrases rather than the exact sentence.
- The rest of the existing doc comment (what `getProfileData` reads and its defaults) stays; only the TODO line is
  replaced.
- Tests for AC-1 to AC-3 go in new test files, not in the existing profile tests, so "existing profile tests stay
  untouched" holds.
- `docs/product/ACTION-APP-CONTRACT.md` is the only file `prettier . --check` flags on this tree (checked this run: it
  is the only file reported), so fixing it makes `npm run format:check` green.
- `package.json` has a real `test` script (`vitest run`), so the test stage can find a runner for the unit criteria;
  AC-3 (running Prettier as a process) is assumed runnable under the same Vitest runner.
